patterns.name: Conceal what need not be revealed
patterns.operational_meaning: Do not volunteer information, intentions, capabilities, weaknesses, relationships, or strategy. Where disclosure is necessary, reveal no more than required or useful.

Do not depend on fabricated facts, forged evidence, false statements, or breach of an affirmative disclosure duty.
